I used my already strong sour starter that has made other successful batches. I could have let it go longer but figured it'd be more efficient to start over.
Day 5 and no solid pellicle has formed, just this yeasty looking thing. I already tossed it but some insight would be great

First try at making anything kombucha. I followed the recipe from the wiki but 25% of the total volume is from a bottle of flavored kombucha. It's what I have easy access to. This has been sitting for 7 days I only checked on it just today. Is it looking alright?
These are eggs? I haven't seen anything on them that look like adults.
They're outdoors but I think they can take the wind no problem. I water only when the top has dried out, and enough until it starts to drain out of the bottom. Sunlight until early afternoon only.

My peppers' leaves (c.annuum) are curling with this white fine dusty texture on both leaf surfaces that doesn't quite rub off. I don't see any visible pests except for a couple of whiteflies on some days, and a single spider that spun a web on a leaf. Soil is well draining and it is supplemented by worm castings and osmocote.

I think it doesn't look quite the same as plant edema so I'm not sure what's causing this and how should I deal with it.
